iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: FreeSurfer fsaverage template, mm (surface RAS of fsaverage, whose volumetric frame is FreeSurfer's MNI305 space). This deposit's README calls the space MNI-305; inferred from the coordinates: every contact's x/y/z equals a vertex of the fsaverage pial surface (within 0.001 mm), consistent with FreeSurfer surface-based normalization of subdural contacts.
iEEGCoordinateProcessingDescription: Post-implant CT and pre-implant MRI were aligned using rigid-body registration without scaling. The accuracy of coregistration was confirmed by visual inspection. Electrode coordinates were then transformed into the FreeSurfer standard brain space.
